notes.title: Winter Sale and Winter Update !
notes.content:
It's that time of the year ! To celebrate the Winter sale, SOMOS just received a Winter update containing a brand new Christmas challenge ! This new challenge also includes a fitting color palette. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/7b84aaab3d89a49d079b8320c289cba4afb3b431.png

In addition, a few challenges have been tweeked, including the infamous Flickers challenge ! You can also enjoy the game at 25% off for the holidays !

Happy holidays !

notes.title: SOMOS patch 1.02
notes.content:
A quick fix was made available today that should fix the issue with the "boss" achievements not being unlocked properly.

You can now get all achievements without issues !

notes.title: SOMOS patch 1.01
notes.content:
SOMOS is now officially out ! You can now explore the different challenges and bring back the colors together.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/77cbbf614b957c04d9a71267803bc57b6a552275.png

If you're having questions about the game, I created a guide that will teach you the basics so that you can start your adventure. You can find it right HERE.

For those looking to prove themselves, I've just fixed an issue that prevented some people to properly upload their best endless score to the leaderboards. If you wish to do so, you can now compare your score among your friends and all other players here.

As you can see, there are already pretty big scores to beat !

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/06d1e97d5761f52b59f4edc070eb47566c1d04fb.png


Good luck !
